content: Ananya Nair followed up on reinstating her expired auto policy (DC-001234), requesting the required steps and any fees. Suresh Deshmukh responded that reinstatement requires payment of the outstanding premium plus a $50 reinstatement fee, and provided a payment link and the reinstatement form.

action_items: Customer to pay outstanding premium and $50 reinstatement fee using the provided payment link.
Agent to await any further questions from the customer.
